title: Chapter 181
text:
The higher-ups of the research institute were very angry. They felt like they had been played like a monkey. However, since the swindler had walked right into their trap, they immediately gloated.

Did he not know whose territory this was? How dare he come here and cause trouble?

In the exhibition room, Kate's expression did not change. He calmly stepped back and adjusted his collar. He looked at Han Xiao arrogantly and said, "If you do anything, such as trying to take me hostage, you will immediately become a sieve. So, don't think about taking risks. Put down your gun and surrender obediently. Then, you can still live."

Han Xiao raised his head and looked at the dark defensive machine gun array. In the corner of the ceiling, there was a surveillance camera. The higher-ups were watching his every move through the surveillance camera. He also knew that the vent could release nerve gas.

He was expressionless as he spoke a voice command.

"Activate program."

The smart chip of the mech instantly recognized the command and processed it into an electromagnetic message. The smart chip of the mech connected to the standby computer and entered the research institute's network. It activated the hacking program that was planted in the research institute the night before.

The research institute's network was like a domino, and this hacking program was the first one to fall. It caused a chain reaction. It did not take much effort to break through the base level of the research institute's network. The control system changed hands within a few seconds.

This was not a hacking program that Han Xiao had written on the spot. He had created all kinds of smart chips before. In order to prevent the control system from being taken away, he had created a lot of anti-hacking programs. At the same time, he had also written some hacking programs. He had never had the chance to use them.

The map of the research institute appeared on the tactical holographic screen. Han Xiao gave the command. The wall of the exhibition room cracked open, and the medicine cabinet appeared again. The machine gun array on the ceiling retracted, and the door opened with a bang.

When he hacked into the research institute's network yesterday, he had seen the structure of the research institute. He already knew the safety measures of the exhibition room. The research institute also had some heavily guarded warehouses that stored a large amount of medicine. However, the amount was too large. Han Xiao could only carry a limited amount of medicine. The amount of medicine in the exhibition room was just right.

The sudden change made the higher-ups of the research institute pale.

"What happened? The system suddenly went out of control!"

"Quickly take back the control!"

The technician on the side was sweating profusely as he typed furiously on the keyboard. Lines of code appeared one after another. Suddenly, the screen turned green and the system crashed. The technician said with a sad face, "No, the hacking speed of the opponent's program is too fast. It can't be solved in a short time!"

"He was already prepared yesterday!" The higher-ups gritted their teeth in hatred.

In the exhibition room, Kate was dumbfounded. Facing Han Xiao's pitch-black goggles, fear gripped his heart. His legs gave way, and he fell to the ground. He said in a panic, "I, I …"

Bang!

A smoking muzzle appeared on the ground between his legs.

Kate was so scared that he peed his pants and didn't dare to move.

"Stay on the side and don't move. You still have a chance to live." Han Xiao's tone was playful.

"Okay, okay, calm down," Kate hurriedly replied. His back was drenched in cold sweat, and he obediently shivered like a quail.

Han Xiao smashed open all the display cabinets. With the enhancement of the mech, the power of his fists was even greater than bullets. He took out his backpack and stuffed all the medicines into it.

He patted his bag in satisfaction. What a bountiful harvest.

At first, he didn't have the intention of robbing the research center until he accidentally heard the conversation between Kate and the higher-ups about Yang Dian and Ned. Since the people in the research center weren't decent people, Han Xiao wasn't interested in talking to them nicely. Since they were all bad people, he would play by the rules of the bad guys. Whoever had the bigger fist could take whatever they wanted.

If the person he talked to had beliefs, ambitions, and a bottom line that he thought was reliable, Han Xiao wouldn't mind talking to them normally. If the person he didn't like and wasn't strong enough, then he wouldn't hold back. He would unleash his original nature as a player and rob whatever he saw. He was very interested in the medicine from the research center. In fact, he liked to win people over with kindness. If they didn't like it, then he would beat them up.

Although Han Xiao didn't love the world as much as the "superheroes" and didn't like the spirit of sacrificing oneself for others, he liked kind people. Being friends with good people in the general sense was, of course, more comfortable than dealing with bad people. Even bad people were more willing to be friends with good people because it was safe and untainted.

Unfortunately, people's morals were deteriorating day by day. "Good people" were becoming fewer and fewer. You couldn't tell which smiling face was hiding evil intentions, and you couldn't tell which "brothers" were willing to sacrifice themselves for each other. On the surface, they called each other brothers, but behind their backs, they were gossiping. Even people from the same hometown would turn around and stab you in the crotch.

Good people were rare animals. They could even be put in zoos … The word "zoo" wasn't appropriate. It would be better to change it to "news broadcast" or "touching China." The research institute played the "heroes" in the palm of their hands because there were such snobbish and hypocritical people. Good people who were straightforward were becoming fewer and fewer, making it harder and harder to survive in society. The construction of spiritual civilization was collapsing … But in a sense, it did feel like "uniqueness".

Most of the time, your persistence was just a duty in the eyes of others, and your hard work was just a means for others to squeeze benefits out of you. People's feelings were not the same, just like how the Louis Research Institution took advantage of Yang Dian and Ned's enthusiasm. It was also like how he took away the hard work of the research institute.

A saying suddenly popped up in Han Xiao's mind. "What goes around comes around. Evil people will naturally be dealt with by evil people."

"I've become an evil person." Han Xiao couldn't help but laugh. It was rare to have the opportunity to do bad things with a clear conscience.

He wouldn't spend money on a target that he could rob. The next time he changed his face, it would be another unfamiliar customer.

Now was not the time to count his gains. Han Xiao carried his backpack and strode to the elevator.

Kate collapsed on the ground and heaved a sigh of relief. She still had some lingering fear.

The upper echelons in the monitoring room saw that all the drugs had been taken away, and their hearts were bleeding. One of the upper echelons said angrily, "Hurry up and think of a way!"

"Got it! Get the control room to cut off all the power in the underground floor and trap him!"

"Ask for help from the Maple government immediately! We still have guards. All of them are gathered at the entrance. As long as we can stall the enemy for fifteen minutes, once the army arrives, I will make sure that he dies without a complete corpse! "

When he reached the elevator, all the lights on the entire floor suddenly went off at the same time. It was pitch black. Han Xiao raised his eyebrows and switched to night vision mode. He laughed in his mind. Cut off the power? I knew it.

Han Xiao bent his legs, and the elastic force generated by the nano muscle fibers gathered in his legs. The ground cracked open, and his entire body was like a cannonball, blasting through the ceiling and directly jumping upstairs.

After two consecutive jumps, Han Xiao crashed into the hall. He immediately saw the bodyguards gathering at the entrance. There were only twenty of them now, not even one-fifth of the total number of guards in the research institute. Han Xiao's way of going upstairs was too fast, and the research institute didn't have much time to react.

The upper echelons of the research institute were shocked by the performance of the mechanical suit. They hurriedly ordered the bodyguards to attack.

"Stall the enemy. The other bodyguards will be here in ten seconds … F * ck!"

Before he could finish his order, Han Xiao had already sprang into action and knocked over the bodyguard in an instant. Like a bowling ball hitting a grand slam, Han Xiao's momentum did not slow down as he smashed through the glass of the door and disappeared into the street. He was so fast that only a black shadow was left in everyone's eyes.

The upper echelons of the research institute were furious. They had high hopes that the bodyguards would be able to stall for at least fifteen minutes, but they didn't even last three seconds.

Seeing that they couldn't get the drugs back, the upper echelons' hearts bled.

"When will the Maple army arrive?"

"At least ten minutes."

"It's too late. That bastard has already escaped. Is there any other way?"

Kate recovered and immediately said, "The two superheroes are still in the city. I'll contact them immediately!"
